Maya (People Ops): Heads up 00 — Ava enrolled in 401(k) and selected catch-up on 2024-07-02 (turns 50 next month) but payroll lines show catch-up posted to Jan-Apr paychecks. Ava, did you submit the election earlier?

Ava (Engineer): No I only submitted on 7/2 in the benefits portal. I noticed a 'CATCHUP' deduction on my 4/12 stub and contacted HR.

Raj (Payroll): Thanks. That looks like the vendor applied the catch-up retroactively using the enrollment effective date field. We need to undo contributions for the incorrect pay periods. Two options: 1) ask recordkeeper to accept a return-of-excess and we reverse payroll deferrals accordingly, or 2) process taxable corrective distribution if recordkeeper can't accept. Prefer option 1.

Maya (People Ops): Recordkeeper is TransAmerica for Ava's plan. I'll open a request. Ava, can you DM your paystub screenshots (no SSNs) so payroll has amounts?

Ava (Engineer): Sent screenshots to Maya.

recordkeeper-bot: Case #7782 opened with TransAmerica. Escalation: payroll-corrections. Expected response 3 business days.

Raj (Payroll): Once TransAmerica confirms, we'll: a) create plan adjustment, b) reverse the catch-up deduction in payroll ledger, c) issue net refund if plan requires funds returned through payroll. Example payroll command I'm prepping: `payrun adjust --employee ava --code CATCHUP_REV --dates 2024-01-26,2024-03-09 --amounts 125.00,125.00 --note "Return excess catch-up pending recordkeeper acceptance"`.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks Raj. Ben from Finance, any preferred GL mapping for the reversal?

(ben-finance): map to 6202-401k-corrections and include journal ref to recordkeeper case id. If refunded to employee, record as liability reduction not income.

Raj (Payroll): noted. I'll log the journal ref when we run corrections. Will post update when TransAmerica responds.

Maya (People Ops): We'll also add a small enrollment checklist item to prevent vendor backfill: ensure effective date in vendor payload is enrollment date + next pay period, not prior months. Raj, can you add that to SOP?

Raj (Payroll): Yep will update SOP and add a test case in the payroll integration tests to catch this. :white_check_mark:
